source_review.read_extent: The full 24-page PDF was retrieved. The cited pages were inspected for the stated results; this is a bounded reading record, not a claim that every line of the paper was studied.
source_review.supports: Provides an independent equivariant K-theory treatment and the finite-slice localization context. The assigned proof supplies its own mapping-cone exactness, finite-cover Mayer–Vietoris, normal Koszul self-intersection, and localization argument.
source_review.limitations: Segal's general equivariant Thom-isomorphism proposition in §3 is not used; the paper itself leaves its general-group proof to a family-index argument. The assigned proof does not import it.
